name: The Seraph's Ledger
description: A personal bundle of small Vintage Story tweaks: a trader ledger that records every trader you visit with map waypoints and an in-game browser, large storage containers (trunk, chest, labeled chest, storage vessel, basket), ctrl+left-click to move all items between open inventories, Sort/Trash buttons in the player inventory, auto-focused creative inventory search, hostile creatures that vanish 2s after death and drop their loot automatically, silenced character voice sounds (player and traders), ice-cooled cellars (stack ice blocks in a cellar to chill it below 5°C so food keeps up to twice as long; cellar ice melts slowly based on the chilled room temperature and never floods the room), a material swatch tool for builders (mark two corners with /sw mark, then Ctrl+Shift+M to swap one building material for another across the whole selection - andesite to chalk, oak to maple - with undo), and a distance-challenge mode. An in-game settings panel (Ctrl+Shift+L) toggles every feature. Ice-cooled cellars are also available on their own as the standalone Ice Cellar mod, and the swatch tool as the standalone Swatch mod; install either alongside this one and it takes over that feature automatically. The hidden-lockbox feature moved to the standalone Hollowstone mod.
